verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS email service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, IMAP/POP/SMTP access and add-ons; these are developer building blocks or adjacent integrations, not an official command-line tool. Nothing in the pack mentions a first-party Gmail CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
